form.p: This template will create a ArithmeticToolGroup API project. Upon creation, the project will have a single example ArithmeticToolGroup interface class. The ArithmeticToolGroup MCP Servers project template can then be used to create an implementation of the ArithmeticTools remote service, an McpSyncServer and an McpAsyncServer. The package name given when creating this project will be required when creating the ArithmeticToolGroup MCP Servers
